name: Houzuki Sayaka
source:
[url=http://vndb.org/c12895]Kaede's[/url] younger sister and [url=http://vndb.org/c12894]Daichi's[/url] youngest daughter. She is also accustomed to wealth. When her father breaks his promise of a family vacation she yells at him that she wishes he were dead.

[spoiler]If she is chosen to inherit her father's estate she runs away and is blackmailed for sex by three elderly men. She puts up with their abuse and even bears them a child so long as they keep her away from her father. She is later caught and impregnated again by her father anyway. [/spoiler]
